name: Into Fenris Keep
summary: A lone body leaves hope that a missing member of the Earthen Ring party may still be alive. You are asked to search Fenris Keep for the captive.

sections.title: A Search in Fenris Keep
sections.body: A member of the Earthen Ring party is missing, and you are asked to search Fenris Keep for them. Trevan and Hadrec described a High Elf inside the nearby fortress. Since only one body was found, there is hope the missing party member is still alive.

sections.title: A Plea for Help
sections.body: Inside Fenris Keep, you find the missing High Elf asking a Forsaken for help to escape. Time is short for the captive.

faq.q: Who am I looking for in Fenris Keep?
faq.answer: You are searching for a missing member of the Earthen Ring party, described by Trevan and Hadrec as a High Elf.

faq.q: Why is there hope the missing person is alive?
faq.answer: Only one body was found, leaving hope that the missing High Elf is still inside Fenris Keep.

faq.q: Who asks me to search Fenris Keep?
faq.answer: The request is to investigate Fenris Keep and try to locate the missing member of the Earthen Ring party.

faq.q: What does the captive ask for?
faq.answer: The captive asks a Forsaken for help to get free, saying time is short.

attribution: In-game quest text: Into Fenris Keep
